div.head: IV As 3.2
div.ab: Hoc autem igitur est, quia iuramenta et uadia, que regi et sapientibus suis data fuerunt, superinfracta sunt et minus obseruata quam (pro) Deo et seculo conueniat.
Hoc autem igitur est quia iuramenta et vadia, quæ regi et sapientibus suis data fuerent, semper infracta sunt et minus observata quam pro Deo et seculo conveniat.

And the reason for this is that the oaths and pledges which were given to the king and his councillors have been continually violated, or observed less strictly than is acceptable to God and to the secular authority.
div.note: Latin only; no German translation in Liebermann. Liebermann compares V As Prol. 3.
